user.title: Add a Bliss blind
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the blind. Pair and set up the blind in the Hunter Douglas app first.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add Bliss blind?
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found a Bliss blind advertising as {name} at {address}. Add it only once nothing else is holding the Bluetooth connection - a blind accepts ONE connection at a time, and the Hunter Douglas app or another integration will fight this one for it.

error.invalid_mac: That is not a valid MAC address. Use the form AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.no_discovery_info: The details of this blind were lost before it could be added. Wait for it to be discovered again, or add it by hand.

data_description.maintenance_mode: ON makes this blind read-only: position, battery and health still update, but it cannot be moved.
data_description.connect_timeout: How long to keep trying to reach the motor before giving up, in seconds.
data_description.speed: The speed this blind moves at: Slow, Comfort or Standard.

preset_add.title: Add a preset
preset_add.description:
Give the preset a name and both rail positions.
Top has to sit above bottom - Home Assistant refuses a position that would drive the rails into each other.

data_description.name: What this preset is called.
data_description.top: Where the top rail stops, as a percentage of its travel.
data_description.bottom: Where the bottom rail stops, as a percentage of its travel.

preset_change.title: Change or delete a preset
preset_change.description:
Leave a field blank to keep what is saved for it.

{presets}

data_description.preset: The preset to change - or the one to remove, if the box below is ticked.
data_description.name: Leave blank to keep the name it has.
data_description.top: Leave blank to keep the saved top position.
data_description.bottom: Leave blank to keep the saved bottom position.
data_description.delete: Removes the chosen preset instead of saving any changes to it.
